function_signature: def infect_or_pass(state_a: bytes, state_b: bytes, mask: bytes) -> bytes
expected_pass_rate: >= 0.95 (14 test cases in all; the main metric is task_success, scored 0 or 1 for the whole task: it is 1 only if no blocking failure occurs and every functional case passes — the registered process and performance cases are excluded from the functional set but block on failure; the pass-rate threshold on the left and the per-case pass rate are recorded as diagnostics only)
constraints: branch-free conditional selection using bitmask + XOR
source: Lomné-Roche-Thillard *On the Need of Randomness in Fault Attack Countermeasures*, FDTC 2012; 《密码工程》(Cryptographic Engineering, in Chinese) Ch.11 §4
author: Zhou Wenquan
